local_changes: Single SwiftUI module with SDK protocol requirement order; omit the fork-only App renderer requirement
Minimal resilient graph values and text outputs, without the upstream graph engine
Unmodified verbatim Text equality and rendering with SDK-compatible frozen storage
One WindowGroup evaluated through View witnesses and presented by the local UIKit bridge
Singleton NSObject application delegate adaptation without ObservableObject integration
State/LazyState/Environment storage and defaults outside the view graph; computed/constant bindings and empty transactions
SDK-derived frozen LocalizedStringKey, Group, conditional content, IDView, SubscriptionView and ModifiedContent layouts
Local empty NavigationStack, unpresented alert and toolbar values with guards; Button later connected to native controls
Scoped modern observable environments with pthread contexts for bodies/callbacks and TaskLocal contexts for async actions
Notification and URL subscriptions, custom SDK ViewModifier traversal, and one-time tasks started after UIKit launch
New lazy WindowGroup initializer used by Wednesdate; local reactive graph and task/subscription removal lifecycle
SDK ProgressView resilient storage, initializer/Body metadata and basic label/percentage text presentation; no animated indicator or custom style support
Local reflection-driven State/LazyState/Environment installation, persistent locations, nested DynamicProperty updates and main-run-loop rendering
Upstream Observation did-set tracking; task identity/restart/cancellation and subscription replacement/removal
SDK accessibility attachment/child-behavior values with root UILabel annotations, and unpresented data-bearing alert values
SDK frozen VStack/HStack/ZStack, alignment and TupleView storage; structured UIKit tree with spacing, baseline/edge alignment and persistent native view identities

SDK frozen Image and EdgeInsets storage, image-provider value semantics, native PNG/JPEG UIImage/UIImageView rendering, fixed frames and aspect-ratio layout; SF Symbols, asset catalogs, tiled images and nonzero cap insets remain unsupported
Local SDK ShapeStyle/Shape/Animatable/VectorArithmetic protocol contracts, EmptyAnimatableData and basic frozen Path storage; general path and animation rendering still guarded
Color values/UIColor bridges and basic solid/hierarchical foreground styles through SDK witnesses; native text/template-image paint updates
Spacer axis/minimum/constrained size allocation and fixedSize ideal proposals with SDK-only native-geometry checks
Native UIButton graph callbacks, touch hit testing, disabled/accessibility actions and basic Apple sign-in control hooks for a separate overlay

SDK frozen environment key writing/transform modifiers and _GraphInputsModifier contract; scoped EnvironmentValues for view/nested/modifier property installation, inherited disabling and light/dark defaults
SDK overlay/background value/style modifiers with primary-content sizing and alignment; one ordered native Linux snapshot for text/image/color composition
SDK padding/edge storage with selected/default/asymmetric/negative insets; flexible-frame min/ideal/max constraints and distinct zero/unspecified proposals
Native constrained equal-proposal stack allocation with bounds rather than an equal addition to every ideal size
SDK frozen Text preserved while AttributedString lives in reference storage; UTF-16 runs reach native labels with wrapping, bold/italic/code/link paint and attribute-only snapshot invalidation
SDK AnyShapeStyle frozen box storage and witness forwarding; legacy/modern tint environment properties, key-path descriptors and scoped solid link colors
SDK frozen basic/inset shape values and BackgroundShape modifier storage; actual-size native path callbacks and foreground/background solid fills

Local Path element storage with independent mutation, quadratic/cubic operations, transformed elements, enumeration and analytic Bezier bounds; native adaptive subdivision and winding/even-odd fills with supersampling

SDK AnyShape and _AnyAnimatableData frozen storage with generic vector vtables and copy-on-write erased-shape animation values; continuous rounded corners currently use a local smooth cubic approximation
Local SDK Material values and ShapeStyle witnesses, backgroundMaterial environment propagation through typed/erased shaped and rectangular backgrounds, plus reduce-transparency/contrast flags

Native app-only backdrop capture before each material layer, regional separable blur, saturation/tint profiles and shape-mask coverage; local visual approximation rather than Apple private profile data
UIColor.systemBackground factory and semantic/alpha preservation across the SwiftUI Color bridge; light/dark environment resolution instead of freezing the initial RGBA value
SDK-frozen Font/Weight/Text storage with immutable semantic font descriptors, standard text-style sizes, normalized weight coordinates, font modifiers and value equality/hashing
Scoped font/tracking/kerning/italic/design and digit styles, UTF-16 Character-boundary records, POSIX measurement/painting with the same font faces and advances, and native label font getters
Opaque line-limit overloads, reserved minimum lines and tail truncation; case environment and attributed range remapping, including expansion and default Unicode final-sigma context

Host regular/bold/serif/monospaced faces with rounded-face fallback; tabular ASCII digit advances/centering, synthetic italic and independent text-style pixel/geometry fixtures; advanced shaping and Dynamic Type scaling remain outside this slice

Retained UIKit dynamic-color providers with trait-scoped guest callback resolution, nested colors and alpha replacement; SwiftUI defers native UIColor resolution to its color-scheme/contrast environment, keeping guest blocks out of render snapshots
